name: Commerce Klarna Payments
description: Off-site Drupal Commerce payment gateway for Klarna Payments (single plugin `klarna_payments`). The Klarna JS widget yields an authorization token; the module creates the Klarna order server-side (amounts built from the Commerce order) and reconciles status by re-fetching the order from Klarna's authenticated Order Management API. The async push, browser return, and fraud-notify webhook are each bound to the Commerce order via the Klarna-generated klarna_order_id, so an order is marked paid only on API-verified AUTHORIZED/PART_CAPTURED/CAPTURED status. Distinct from commerce_klarna and commerce_klarna_checkout.
